        "Full two-file owned diff read, including the complete new111-line xpcshell test and manifest entry. Sets up a local EwsServer/account and root sync, then creates20 messages, marks every even-indexed subject TOP-SECRET, limits server sync batches to4, and creates an enabled Subject Contains filter with MarkRead action. The indexed forEach uses the actual index to choose alternate messages; do not rewrite it merely as a loop-style exercise.",
        "The owned test waits only for getNewMessages URL completion before checking total20, unread10 and each header subject-marker equality with isRead. The total-count Assert.equal has no message; the other2 assertion sites have nonempty should messages. It directly tests subject-based read marking for all headers. It does not assert message-body filters, moves, spam classification, per-page request counts or notification ordering, even though collection/filter paths execute.",
        "Fixed accepted path is protocols/exchange, distinct from owned protocols/ews and interface IEwsIncomingServer. Accepted test adds a state-condition wait for unread count to differ from total after URL completion; do not attribute that later wait or universal action-completion semantics to the initial test. PromiseUrlListener resolves from exact NS_OK and rejects other exits; the caller must still wait for the state it asserts when URL completion is earlier than local mutation.",
        "Cleanup is registered only after server start and initial sync, and the test directly sets mail.suppressAlertsForTests without explicit restoration in this file. The connection-error comment identifies a bounded historical workaround, not proof of Bug1982958 cause or fix. No EWS server, account, filter, assertion, test, build, lint or runtime was executed.",
        "Reuse exact complete primary Bug1975717 already read for C3304. Read D260926 complete timeline and both actual inline bodies with their submitted old/new comment code, no summary edits. Reviewer explicitly requests a neutral explanation of the windowless test state and why mail.suppressAlertsForTests is needed. Author calls the earlier wording a placeholder and files separate1982958. Owned final test comment explains the delayed connection-error/alert/window assertion path rather than preserving the joking complaint.",

The review allows landing after comment adjustment without another review; actual source confirms the comment phase. Timeline explicitly says landed with ongoing or failed builds before later completion, so acceptance is not an all-green check or fresh test run. Original assertions, missing total-count message and later unread-state wait remain unchanged source findings."
